build_SCAN_dataset: run the build function to download and prepare the SCAN dataset for ParlAI
create_fb_format_train_valid_test: create a ParlAI fbformat text file from SCAN IN/OUT data with train valid or test splitting
download_SCAN_resources: download the SCAN dataset tarball using the RESOURCES DownloadableFile list
refactor_create_fb_format: refactor create_fb_format to support custom line splitting logic for train and valid sets
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how SCAN data is downloaded and converted to fbformat
